text: Handling deadlines well requires good time management and clear planning. Start by breaking large tasks into smaller steps and setting a realistic schedule. Prioritization is also important: focus on the most urgent and important work first, and avoid wasting time on low-value activities. Sometimes you may need scope management, which means reducing what you promise if time is short. Finally, communication matters. If a deadline is at risk, tell your team or manager early instead of waiting until the last minute. By planning carefully, choosing priorities wisely, adjusting scope when necessary, and keeping others informed, you can reduce stress and meet deadlines more reliably.
